title: 垫子下面留空
description: 成人把自己的小包移到垫区外长凳旁，墙下保持空旷。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult sets a small gear bag beside a bench outside the padded landing area, leaving the space beneath the low wall clear. The adult bends with soft knees and uses both hands on the bag, while a companion waits nearby on ordinary flooring. Large easy holds and uninterrupted mats are visible behind them, with no person climbing. Use a wide low perspective to make the tidy separation of belongings and practice space obvious.
